key.name: preset
key.description: The colour shift preset to apply (red, green, blue, red-mono, green-mono, amber, sepia, grayscale). CRT is a separate overlay switch, not a preset.

key.name: favorites
key.description: Preset ids shown as radio items in the Quick Settings dropdown; everything else is configured in the preferences window.

key.name: crt
key.description: Apply the CRT effect on top of the selected colour mode.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether the colour shift filter is currently applied.

key.name: crt-scanline
key.description: How strongly the horizontal scanlines are darkened (0-1).

key.name: crt-mask
key.description: Strength of the RGB aperture-grille / "window screen" mask (0-1).

key.name: crt-bloom
key.description: Amount of multi-tap phosphor bloom added around bright areas (0-1).

key.name: crt-glow
key.description: Radial glass glow strongest in the centre of the tube (0-1).

key.name: crt-vignette
key.description: Darkening toward the outer edges of the tube (0-1).

key.name: crt-curvature
key.description: Whether to apply barrel distortion (glass bulge).

key.name: crt-curvature-amount
key.description: Barrel-distortion strength when curvature is enabled.
